<!-- Write the title and body in English. See the development guidance below. -->

## Problem

Describe the problem and who or what it affects.

## Expected outcome

Describe what should be true when this Issue is resolved.

## Context

Add relevant files, examples, logs, and related Issues. For bugs, include reproduction steps, expected and actual behavior, and relevant browser/extension versions. Omit reproduction steps when they do not apply.

## Pre-merge acceptance

List concrete mandatory criteria that can be achieved and verified before merge, preferably as checkboxes.

Default to criteria an AI agent can execute and verify. Require human confirmation, physical-device testing, subjective evaluation, or external approval only when necessary for this Issue; explain why and what result is expected. Do not make checks possible only after merge prerequisites for approval. See the [development guidance](https://github.com/takahirox/WebXR-emulator-extension/blob/dev/docs/development-flow.md#1-start-with-an-issue).

## Optional validation

List helpful additional checks separately from mandatory acceptance, or state that none are needed.

## Required post-merge verification

None, unless this Issue needs checks possible only after merge. If needed, describe the checks and expected results separately; report them as pending until performed. Pre-merge validation does not prove deployment or publication succeeded. See the [review guidance](https://github.com/takahirox/WebXR-emulator-extension/blob/dev/docs/review-guidelines.md#check-pre-merge-acceptance-and-post-merge-verification).
